language: Go (github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/v2 v2.6.0, go1.26.0 darwin/arm64, std net/http; built with CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w")
notes: A2A spec 1.0 JSON-RPC binding (method 'SendMessage'). Built like the SDK's examples/helloworld/server/jsonrpc: http.ServeMux with '/' -> a2asrv.NewJSONRPCHandler(a2asrv.NewHandler(executor)) and a2asrv.WellKnownAgentCardPath -> a2asrv.NewStaticAgentCardHandler(card). Default std-lib http.Server (only ReadHeaderTimeout=10s set). GOMAXPROCS and GOGC are left at their defaults, so it uses every core. NewHandler defaults: taskstore.NewInMemory and eventqueue.NewInMemoryManager, no concurrency limit, no logging interceptor (no per-request logs). Persistence: none. The executor yields a single agent Message (message-only interaction), so the task store is never written. The per-request event queue is destroyed after the reply. No disk I/O, no fsync. Auth/crypto: none - no TLS (plain HTTP on loopback), no authentication, no message signing or verification, unsigned agent card. The server does not check the A2A-Version header (it is sent anyway, to match the spec and the Python target). Errors come back as HTTP 200 with a JSON-RPC 'error' member. The server does not deduplicate on messageId. Success response: HTTP 200, headers Content-Type: application/json, Date, Content-Length; body {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":<request id>,"result":{"message":{"messageId":<server uuidv7>,"contextId":<server uuidv7>,"parts":[{"text":"ok"}],"role":"ROLE_AGENT"}}} plus a trailing newline (json.Encoder). install_paths: one static stripped binary, 6,553,650 bytes. The module lives in bench/competitors/a2a-go with its own go.mod (module silkbench/a2a-go) and is independent of the repo root module.
